interface.name: post_apollo_weather_watch_v1

description.summary: paired Weather Station NEWS request, non-authorizing

interface.description: Requests originate from the exact compositor-paired Weather Station Wayland client. A successful response is candidate evidence ONLY. The protocol cannot launch browsers, draw scenes, route input or permit popups. There is no URL or client-chosen process ID.

entry.name: denied
entry.summary: no valid host pairing or stale origin

entry.name: candidate_only
entry.summary: native request recognized, no playback authority

arg.name: x
arg.summary: inner left relative to the Weather host

arg.name: y
arg.summary: inner top relative to the Weather host

arg.name: width
arg.summary: inner width (zero with all fields zero means hidden)

entry.name: denied
entry.summary: not paired, stale, malformed or outside native host

entry.name: candidate_only
entry.summary: bounded geometry observed, no scene or input rights

entry.name: hidden
entry.summary: reported viewer is closed and receipt cleared

arg.name: host_revision_hi
arg.summary: upper 32 bits of compositor-owned host revision

arg.name: host_revision_lo
arg.summary: lower 32 bits of compositor-owned host revision
